sites.name: The Long Silence
sites.blurb: A hauler down on the ice north of the pads, half-buried and still calling.
sites.hook: Her beacon has been repeating the same six seconds since before anyone at Frostwatch arrived. The Bonefield yardmaster will pay for anything brought back off her.

sites.name: Kettle Deep
sites.blurb: The cuts below Kettle Hollow, where the colony stopped digging and will not say why.
sites.hook: The Hollow's Keeper will not discuss what is under the floor of their own colony. The meltwater coming up from it runs warm.

sites.name: The Bonefield Underhang
sites.blurb: A void under the salvage yard, opened when a hull section finally went through the ice.
sites.hook: Kesh Duval lost two cutters down there and has stopped sending people after them.
